mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions characterized by high consumer confidence, a rising housing starts index (HOUST) signals increased residential investment that boosts economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC during late-cycle periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past quarter indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS has increased for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 in a month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply chain disruption (as indicated by a decline in industrial production), a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures that lead to central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past three months indicates a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE has declined for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.02.
